reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets doubled since August and kept rising into September (E-07), driven primarily by a billing-import processing defect — consistent with a change to billing import validation rules around August — that produces incorrect bills on accounts with accepted ACTUAL meter reads. The majority of disputed bills (1,785 of 3,025) are tied to ACTUAL, not ESTIMATED, reads (E-01), while tariff changes (E-02/E-05) and slow ticket response (E-04) are ruled out as drivers.
